root_cause: The focus trap's getFocusableNodes includes hidden elements (e.g., display:none buttons) in the focusable nodes array. This causes the Tab key navigation to attempt focusing a hidden button, which fails and leaves focus on the previous element, breaking the expected wrap to the close button.
repair_strategy: Modify getFocusableNodes to filter out elements that are not visibly rendered (display:none, visibility:hidden), so the focusable nodes array only contains elements that can actually receive focus. This ensures the existing focus trap logic (which wraps at the first/last visible element) works correctly.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users tabbing through the upload dialog will cycle among the visible controls (file name input, Upload button, Close button) without escaping to external content, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 and 2.4.3.
functional_risks: Filtering by computed style may have a small performance cost when opening modals or on each Tab keydown, but the modal is small.
If an element is hidden via other means (e.g., opacity:0, clip-path) it may still be included; however, such elements are typically not focusable by the browser anyway.
verification_requirements: After opening the modal, focus starts on the filename input.
Pressing Tab moves focus to the Upload button.
Another Tab moves focus to the close button.
Another Tab wraps focus back to the filename input.
Escape key still closes the modal and returns focus to the trigger button.
